metric_formula.engine_tpot_s: (completion_time_ns - first_output_token_time_ns) / ((output_token_count - 1) * 1e9), for output_token_count > 1; zero for one token
metric_formula.tpot_s: (stream_completion_time_ns - first_stream_token_received_time_ns) / ((output_token_count - 1) * 1e9), for output_token_count > 1; zero for one token

timestamp_definition.arrival_time_ns: actual open-loop launch time immediately before Engine.add_request_and_stream
timestamp_definition.clock: time.perf_counter_ns monotonic process clock for *_time_ns fields
timestamp_definition.completion_time_ns: time after model.forward returned the final token and before StepOutput enqueue
timestamp_definition.first_output_token_time_ns: time after model.forward returned the batch containing the first output token
timestamp_definition.first_prefill_time_ns: time immediately before the model forward containing the request's first prefill
timestamp_definition.first_stream_token_received_time_ns: time benchmark consumer received the first StepOutput
timestamp_definition.planned_arrival_offset_s: offered schedule offset from measurement start
timestamp_definition.scheduler_eligible_time_ns: time when tokenization completed and Engine called Scheduler.on_requests_arrival
timestamp_definition.stream_completion_time_ns: time benchmark consumer received the final StepOutput
